description: A single rendered data table (no micrographs, curves or plots) titled by its caption as "Elemental composition of 35 h milled powder samples by full area and point EDS analysis". The table has a left column "Sample condition", a second column "Scan area", and a spanning header "Elemental composition (at%)" subdivided into five element columns: Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si. Only one sample condition is tabulated: "35 h milled powder", listed against three scan areas — "Full area", "Spot 1" and "Spot 2". Full area: Fe 42.0, Mn 21.0, Ni 13.0, Al 13.0, Si 9.0 at%. Spot 1: Fe 54.0, Mn 22.0, Ni 14.0, Al 6.0, Si 4.0 at%. Spot 2: Fe 34.0, Mn 61.0, Ni 0.6, Al 4.0, Si 0.2 at%. The table therefore demonstrates that the 35 h milled powder is chemically heterogeneous at the point-analysis scale: the full-area average lies near the nominal Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 composition, while Spot 2 is strongly Mn-enriched and almost depleted in Ni and Si, consistent with incomplete alloying or Mn-rich particulate regions after mechanical alloying. All values are printed as at%; no error bars, uncertainties or C values appear.

subfigures.description: Single rendered table giving EDS elemental composition (at%) for the 35 h milled powder measured over the full area and at two spots; columns are Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si for scan areas Full area, Spot 1 and Spot 2.

observations.observation: The figure is a table headed 'Elemental composition (at%)' with columns Fe, Mn, Ni, Al, Si and rows for the scan areas 'Full area', 'Spot 1' and 'Spot 2' of a '35 h milled powder'.
Full area composition of the 35 h milled powder is printed as Fe 42.0, Mn 21.0, Ni 13.0, Al 13.0, Si 9.0 at%.
Spot 1 composition is printed as Fe 54.0, Mn 22.0, Ni 14.0, Al 6.0, Si 4.0 at%.
Spot 2 composition is printed as Fe 34.0, Mn 61.0, Ni 0.6, Al 4.0, Si 0.2 at%.

Spot 2 is strongly Mn-enriched (61.0 at%) and almost free of Ni (0.6 at%) and Si (0.2 at%) relative to the full-area value, indicating strong point-to-point chemical heterogeneity in the 35 h milled powder.
At Spot 1 the Al (6.0 at%) and Si (4.0 at%) contents are roughly half their full-area values (13.0 and 9.0 at%), while Fe is higher (54.0 vs 42.0 at%).
Across the three analyses Fe ranges from 34.0 to 54.0 at% and Mn from 21.0 to 61.0 at%.
The table reports only Fe, Mn, Ni, Al and Si; no carbon content is listed although the alloy designation in the paper title includes C1.
The caption states the data are elemental composition of 35 h milled powder samples obtained by full area and point EDS analysis.
No uncertainties, standard deviations or number of measured points are printed anywhere in the table.

The full-area average (Fe 42.0, Mn 21.0, Ni 13.0, Al 13.0, Si 9.0 at%) is close to the nominal Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 alloy composition given in the paper title, whereas the two spot analyses deviate from it.
